EmailTemplate.subject: Thank you for your interest in the PhD in sustainability at ASU
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
{!Contact.FirstName},
Thank you for your interest in the sustainability doctoral (PhD) program. Specific application requirements and top reasons students choose the ASU School of Sustainability are listed on our website.
We encourage you to contact faculty prior to applying. Applicants are asked to identify potential faculty advisors in the application materials. Please take time to learn about our faculty and the current sustainability research projects underway at ASU.
We are happy to answer any additional questions you have. To schedule an in-person, phone or Skype appointment, please call our office at 480-727-6963 during our office hours, Monday through Friday, 9a.m. – 4p.m.
Regards,
Katerina Kinast Graduate Academic Success Coordinator ASU School of Sustainability Katie.Kinast@asu.edu
